backgroundPolicy.uiScreenshots: Use title/menu/loading/save/social-stat/fusion screenshots as design references, not as the page background. Recreate the interaction with original portfolio content.
backgroundPolicy.loadingScreens: Use only verified official P3R loading/presentation art if found and cleared. Do not assume an image called loading screen is a separate official wallpaper; record the exact source and permission before adding it.
backgroundPolicy.rights: Every source URL remains reference-only until public web display, local hosting and permitted crop/transform operations are explicitly covered.
